# Which patent fees are due, when does the surcharge start, and what will the portfolio cost?

> When is each US patent maintenance fee due, when does the surcharge start, and when does the patent expire? Paste your patents and grant dates for every deadline, a multi-year fee budget, what dropping a patent saves, and a calendar file. Free, runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
